notes.title: Colorvore - Version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Changes

Added leaderboard.
Altered UI.


As a game that was meant to be in the retro-cabinet style, I knew something was missing. Now the top ten scores will be shown for all to see.

Compete for the highest score arcade style!
